Maria / Priya —

I've started a correlation run against our regional telemetry. Quick notes:
- We observed elevated queueing on a small pool of inference routers in us-west-2 at ~08:22–08:50 PDT; CPU and GPU utilization were within expected bounds but scheduling latencies (node-level) spiked on three hosts that experienced transient IO stalls.
- Error rate on our side did not meet the threshold for a full "Unavailable" SLO (5xx remained within normal variance), but the latency envelope did exceed the p99 threshold you referenced.

Next steps (technical):
1) Can you attach a minimal reproducible curl or sample request IDs (trace ids) from your side so we can do request-level matching? That will speed up exact-impact reconciliation.
2) I'm packaging a trimmed pcap and trace bundle — will attach in a separate encrypted link due to size.
3) If you prefer faster turnaround we can start a joint debugging session with your SREs today 14:00 PDT.

For credit calculation: because our errors did not breach the Unavailable bucket, this will likely be considered a partial-latency event rather than a full outage. Per contract language (section 4.2), that typically maps to a prorated remedial credit based on affected requests/time-in-window. We will provide a preliminary number once we reconcile request counts.
